duplicates.sweep_f978923aeaa98920: The candidate carries CVE-2024-50614 for the same snapshot and the same advisory range (OSV: introduced 0, last_affected 321ea883 = tag 10.0.0). That is the defect promoted from disc2_c259dbfa630800a8b2a454ac: XMLUtil::GetCharacterRef assertion overflow in tinyxml2.cpp, fixed by 494735de in 10.1.0. No second root cause, so this row is an alias cluster.

notes: CVE-2024-50614 is promoted at XMLUtil::GetCharacterRef (tinyxml2.cpp:475-568): the numeric-reference accumulator is bounded only by TIXMLASSERT checks (:519-559), which are active only with TINYXML2_DEBUG; 8 hex digits or 10 decimal digits reach mult > UINT_MAX/16 and abort the process while parsing an entity in any attribute or text node. Fixed in 10.1.0 by 494735de / merge 4cbb2515 (PR #1009), which caps ucs at 0x10FFFF.

Release builds (TIXMLASSERT a no-op) wrap the unsigned arithmetic and ConvertUTF32ToUTF8 returns length 0 for input >= 0x200000; that is recorded as a static fact, not as a second impact, and the row category is denial_of_service.

Severity is the only published CVSS for this CVE (Secondary CNA metric 6.5 MEDIUM, AV:N/AC:L/PR:N/UI:R/S:U/C:N/I:N/A:H), matching GHSA-xpm9-95h9-q996; tier T2 / review status unknown because the advisory is a CVE/GHSA global record with no vendor advisory and the defect was reported through issue #996.
